content.value_statement: Teams often need consistent visual design across slides, reports, pages, and documents. Theme Factory provides preset palettes and font pairings that Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can apply to an artifact.
actual_capabilities: Shows a bundled PDF showcase of ten available themes.
Guides the user to choose a theme before applying changes.
Applies selected color palettes and font pairings to slides or other artifacts.
Uses theme files that define colors, fonts, and visual identity.
Can generate a custom theme from a user description when presets do not fit.
Emphasizes contrast, readability, and consistent visual identity.
limitations: It does not automatically verify visual rendering across every output format.
The bundled PDF preview requires a viewer that can open PDF files.
Custom themes depend on the quality and specificity of the user description.
It provides styling guidance, not brand compliance or accessibility certification.

use_cases.title: Style a presentation deck
use_cases.description: Apply a coherent theme to slides so colors, fonts, and visual tone match the presentation goal.

use_cases.title: Refresh a report design
use_cases.description: Use a preset palette and font pairing to make a report look polished and consistent.

use_cases.title: Create a custom visual direction
use_cases.description: Generate a new theme from a short description when the ten included themes are not suitable.

prompt_templates.title: View available themes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request to browse presets before choosing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the Theme Factory showcase and help me choose a theme for my artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.scenario: User already knows which preset they want.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck. Keep the content unchanged and update only the visual styling.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend a theme for a goal
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants guidance based on audience and tone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend one Theme Factory preset for an executive strategy presentation. Explain why it fits before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Create a custom theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a new visual identity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a healthcare analytics report. Use calm colors, strong readability, and a professional font pairing, then show it for review.

output_examples.input: Apply the Modern Minimalist theme to my report.
output_examples.output: The report uses a clean grayscale palette, restrained accent colors, and consistent header and body font styling.

output_examples.input: Help me choose a theme for a nature-focused deck.
output: Forest Canopy is suitable for grounded environmental content.
Botanical Garden is suitable for fresher, organic visuals.
After selection, the chosen colors and fonts are applied consistently.

output_examples.input: Create a custom theme for a fintech landing page.
output_examples.output: A custom theme is proposed with a confident palette, modern typography, and guidance for headings, body text, and accents.

best_practices: Review the theme showcase before choosing a preset.
Confirm the target audience and tone before applying a theme.
Check contrast and readability after styling the artifact.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme before the user confirms the choice.
Do not change the artifact content when only styling was requested.
Do not use a custom theme without showing it for review first.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps apply preset or custom color and font themes to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill lists ten preset themes, each with a distinct visual identity.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a custom theme from a description when the preset themes do not fit.

faq.question: Does it edit the content of my artifact?
faq.answer: The skill focuses on visual styling. You should specify if content changes are also desired.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is the PDF showcase required?
faq.answer: The PDF helps users preview available themes, but the theme files also contain the styling specifications.
